### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **14** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**9** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx`  _(via confirmText (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_
- `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`  _(via confirmText (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_
- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`  _(via successMessage (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_
- `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`  _(via successMessage (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`  _(via confirmText (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via disabledReason (symbol, a field of interface ActionLike), confirmText (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField), disabledReason (literal, a string literal in actionObject; a string literal in actionTranslationSchema; a string literal in collectExpectedEntries; a string literal in lookupActionField; a string literal in sections; a string literal in translateAction), successMessage (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/record-alert.mdx`  _(via confirmText (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField), successMessage (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_
- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`  _(via confirmText (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField), successMessage (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_
- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`  _(via confirmText (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField), successMessage (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via confirmText (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField), successMessage (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via successMessage (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-1.mdx`  _(via confirmText (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField), successMessage (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx`  _(via confirmText (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField), successMessage (literal, a string literal in lookupActionField))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **55** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **154** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8b276385e6f1e2b94a4061160c148cfa56f81588` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `288882c00660338824e8b044e427022744a9545b` — the merge of head `c9d6d356f73771753b20bde48dbef24d9120692e` into base `8b276385e6f1e2b94a4061160c148cfa56f81588`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 288882c00660338824e8b044e427022744a9545b && git checkout 288882c00660338824e8b044e427022744a9545b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8b276385e6f1e2b94a4061160c148cfa56f81588 c9d6d356f73771753b20bde48dbef24d9120692e && git checkout -B drift-repro 8b276385e6f1e2b94a4061160c148cfa56f81588 && git merge --no-ff c9d6d356f73771753b20bde48dbef24d9120692e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8b276385e6f1e2b94a4061160c148cfa56f81588
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8b276385e6f1e2b94a4061160c148cfa56f81588` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c81d8630e4f132d4cafb2b490bb678f637377a57`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/action.form.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts + packages/spec/src/ui/i18n.zod.ts (`InlineLocaleMapSchema`), packages/spec/src/shared/refinement-projection.ts (`NON_BLANK_STRING`), packages/spec/src/ui/action-disabled-reason.test.ts, packages/spec/liveness/action.json, packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts, packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts (+ .test.ts), packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts (+ .test.ts), packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts, .changeset/26619-action-disabled-reason.md, content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/*.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-quick-actions.tsx

Ruling executed: 6442737825 on #26619, letter A. Inputs read: the card body and all five comments (triage 6440296436, brief 6441887048, ruling 6442737825, claim 6444476085, os-dev-report 6446453447), the PR body, its 24-file list, the net diff `a485b5a3..c81d8630e` (24 files, +505/−11, matching the file list exactly), and the check-runs on the head.

**Head provenance.** `c81d8630e` is a merge of `origin/main` `a485b5a3` into the branch's three commits (`13e780bb`, `aa552ced`, `1d2b0252`). `git diff a485b5a3..c81d8630e` is byte-identical to the branch's own pre-merge diff (`merge-base(1d2b0252, a485b5a3)..1d2b0252`): the merge adds nothing beyond the PR's net diff, with no conflict resolution. `origin/main` has since advanced three commits (`a9f654eb`, `785a7c3b`, `0f3d068c`) that touch four PR paths — `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` at `SYSTEM_FIELD_LABELS` (~line 3556, the ADR-0142 `queue` label) and the three non-English `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` bundles (+8 lines each, other keys) — all disjoint from this PR's hunks. A textual merge is expected to be clean; the queue leg performs it.

**Check-runs on the head at review time** (two REST reads, 15:50Z and ~16:05Z): 48 runs — 22 `success`, 9 `skipped`, 17 `in_progress` (Test Core 1–8, Build Core, Build Docs, Type Check × 5 incl. Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Lint · repo & tooling gates), 0 `failure`. The derived gate families (`check:liveness`, `check:generated`, `check:api-surface`, dropped-refinements, `check:skill-examples`, `check:i18n-coverage`, typecheck, the spec/lint/cli test suites) had therefore NOT rendered their verdicts when this record was written; nothing was red. This record judges the tree; the queue guard still holds the PR until every check is green, as Tier S requires.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`ActionSchema.disabledReason` — optional, display-only, I18nLabel: RIGHT.** `action.zod.ts` adds `disabledReason: actionDisabledReason().optional()` beside `disabled` on `actionObject()`, where `actionDisabledReason = z.union([z.string().refine(NON_BLANK_STRING, …), InlineLocaleMapSchema])`. An action without it parses unchanged (test "is optional"); `InlineActionSchema` (`.pick()` of `type/name/label/target/openIn/method/params/bodyExtra/confirmText/successMessage/errorMessage/refreshAfter/opensInNewTab`) picks neither `disabled` nor the new key, so the inline toolbar action is correctly left out — nothing there to explain. The authorable surface gains exactly `ui/Action:disabledReason`.
2. **Blank string refused, and the refusal projects: RIGHT.** `NON_BLANK_STRING` (`refinement-projection.ts:263`, `source.trim().length > 0`, declared `pattern: 'non-blank-string'`) is the registry-declared predicate, so the published `json-schema/ui/Action.json` (gitignored build output, line 63 of `.gitignore`) carries `minLength`/`pattern: "\\S"` and `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` is untouched — the diff adds no ledger row. `''` and `'   '` are refused at path `['disabledReason']` with a message naming the default and the omit remedy (tests pin both).
3. **Blank INSIDE the inline map is NOT refused — and the changeset and the protocol doc say it is: WRONG (prose, not code).** `InlineLocaleMapSchema` (`i18n.zod.ts:216–227`) is `z.record(key-regex, z.string())`: `{}` and `{ en: '' }` both parse. The code is consistent with the ruling, which names the empty string. But `.changeset/26619-action-disabled-reason.md` states "A blank reason is refused at parse: `''`, a whitespace-only string, an empty map, or a map with a blank value", and `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` states "A blank reason (`''`, whitespace, or a map with a blank value) is refused at parse". The PR body's acceptance note concedes the opposite ("A blank value inside an inline locale map is not refused"). Judged under ② below.
4. **Translation slot at `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.disabledReason` AND `globalActions.ACTION.disabledReason`: RIGHT, and the second address is a sound extension, not an overreach.** `actionTranslationSchema(surface)` (`translation.zod.ts:177`) is ONE factory instantiated at both addresses; `confirmText` / `successMessage` — the siblings the ruling names — already live at both. `actionTranslationNode` (`i18n-resolver.ts`) reads a bound action ONLY at `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION` and an object-less action ONLY at `globalActions.ACTION`, with no fallback. Declaring the key at the object address alone would leave every object-less action with no slot at all, which the ruling's "beside confirmText / successMessage" does not intend. Both address lists in the docblocks (`i18n-resolver.ts` header, `ObjectTranslationDataSchema`, `appTranslationDataShape`) are updated; the near-miss rename map (`disabledMessage` / `disabledTooltip` / `disabledHint` / `disabledText` → `disabledReason`) is mirrored on the action and on the bundle.
5. **`translateAction` overlays it like `description`: RIGHT.** `lookupActionField` gains the `'disabledReason'` literal; `translateAction` does `lookupActionField(…, 'disabledReason') ?? action.disabledReason` and spreads the key only when defined (test "adds no key to an action that declares none"). `ActionLike.disabledReason?: string` is narrowed to `string` exactly as `description` is (`ActionLike.description?: string` against an I18nLabel authoring site): an authored inline map passes through untouched, the same contract `description` has. Tests cover the object address, the global address, the fallback, and the no-key case.
6. **i18n extract emits it: RIGHT.** `collectExpectedEntries` adds `pushOptional(out, [...root, 'disabledReason'], action.disabledReason, kind, { objectName })` at both the object-action site and the global/inline-object site, `pushOptional` like `description` (an absent reason seeds nothing), with the header address list updated at both addresses. Covered by the new cli test.
7. **Never enters server admission: RIGHT.** `git grep disabledReason` over the head tree outside tests finds the key only in the five spec/cli files above, one lint comment, and the four `metadata-forms` bundles. Every `ui/` hit (`containers.tsx#disabledReasonFor`, `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx:598`, `record-quick-actions.tsx:464`, the `action-*.tsx` renderers' `useDisabledReason`, `HomePage.tsx`) is a LOCAL identifier bound to the generic sentence or to a hook result — no `ui/` or `packages/{core,rest,runtime,metadata}` path reads `action.disabledReason`. Server refusal stays the hook's / `requiredPermissions`'.
8. **Lint never reads it as a predicate: RIGHT.** `validate-expressions.ts` reads `action.disabled` alone (line 3346–3347) and `action.visible`; the literal-member census `READ_SURFACES[receiver='action'].expected` stays `['disabled', 'name', 'objectName', 'visible']` (the PR adds only a comment there plus the pin "never reads `disabledReason` as a predicate", which feeds a bare-field source — an error on `disabled` — into `disabledReason` and expects zero issues). The parse test pins that a predicate-looking value survives verbatim while `disabled` is lowered to its `{dialect:'cel'}` envelope. `validate-translation-references.ts` changes a docblock only (the leaf-key list), and its test's coverage table gains `disabledReason: { kind: 'leaf-copy', why: 'prose' }` — the pin that reds when the action translation shape declares a key the table does not classify. Neither reads the key as a condition.
9. **Liveness row `planned`: the STATE is right; the row is INCOMPLETE for the window it describes — WRONG as shipped.** `lint-liveness-properties.ts:182–189`: "`planned` is deliberately absent [from the verdicts that warn on their own]: a planned key is one the platform asks authors to write, so it warns only where its row opts in" — i.e. only with `authorWarn: true`. The new row in `liveness/action.json` carries `status`, `verifiedAt`, `evidence`, `note` and NO `authorWarn`. So the changeset's closing sentence ("an author declaring it gets the planned-property warning that says so") and the PR body's 「作者会收到 planned 提示」 are false in the tree: between this landing — and the release the ruling says carries the key before hotclm#169 adds its line — and the console PR, an author who declares the key gets no signal that nothing renders it. The precedent row in the same ledger (`outcomeMessages`, line 108 note) ran its own planned window with `authorWarn` + `authorHint` and dropped both on the flip to `live`, which is the discipline `check-liveness.mts#scanAuthorWarnRows` enforces (a warned `live` row reds the gate). `planned` is otherwise the correct grade: `dead` would prescribe "Remove it", `experimental` is for a declared-but-unenforced guarantee, and the gate scans a `planned` row's `evidence` pointers (`EVIDENCE_SCANNED_STATUSES`), which here resolve to `i18n-resolver.ts#translateAction`, `i18n-extract.ts#collectExpectedEntries` and `translation.zod.ts`. A `planned` key in a published schema is explicitly allowed (10 planned rows on the census the gate header cites; no describe-marker is required when the ledger row grades it — `led?.status || markerStatus(description)`, line 1219).
10. **Studio form row: RIGHT.** `action.form.ts` adds `{ field: 'disabledReason', helpText: … }` under `disabled` with no `widget`, mirroring the `errorMessage` row (`errorMessage: I18nLabelSchema.optional()`, `action.zod.ts:1466`). The node is not `I18nLabelSchema` by identity, but the Studio derives the face from the published JSON Schema: `SchemaForm.tsx` picks the best-matching `anyOf` branch and its string-arm detector walks nested `anyOf` (its own docblock example is `{ type: 'string', minLength: 1 }`), so the refined string arm keeps the I18nLabel face. The `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` leaf carries the form's `helpText` byte-for-byte; the three other locales carry hand-written leaves, which is the file header's documented editing model ("Edit translations in place").
11. **Public type surface.** `ActionLike` (exported from `i18n-resolver.ts`) gains an optional member; `lookupActionField`'s `field` literal union widens (module-private). `check:api-surface` records export existence, not members (AGENTS.md), so no snapshot change is owed; `check:generated` was 14/14 after the dev's `--fix` and CI re-runs it.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/26619-action-disabled-reason.md`: `@objectstack/spec: minor`, `@objectstack/cli: minor`, `@objectstack/platform-objects: minor`; `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; `Metadata-protocol: added`. The PR body carries the same two lines.

- **Level: RIGHT.** The diff adds an authorable key and a translation leaf (kind `added`), so every package the diff moves takes at least `minor` (AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3): spec (the key), cli (extract emits it), platform-objects (four bundle leaves). `@objectstack/lint` moves only a docblock and two test files and takes no changeset — defensible; CI's changeset-coverage gate is the authority if it disagrees.
- **Clause-②: yes (widening) — RIGHT.** One optional key added on a `strictObject`; the four near-miss spellings were already refused as `unrecognized_keys` and now refuse with a rename hint; no accept-set narrows anywhere. **Metadata-protocol: added — RIGHT** (a new key an author can write; several-kinds precedence does not apply, nothing is narrowed or re-meant).
- **Body matches what the diff publishes: WRONG on two sentences — MUST-FIX.** The changeset ships as `CHANGELOG.md` and promises (i) refusal of "an empty map, or a map with a blank value" that `InlineLocaleMapSchema` does not make (①.3), and (ii) "an author declaring it gets the planned-property warning" that the ledger row does not opt into (①.9). The same (i) sentence is in `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`. Each is cured either by making the tree say it (for (ii): `authorWarn: true` + an `authorHint` on the row, the `outcomeMessages` precedent; for (i): a record-value refinement the projection can publish, if the dev wants it — the acceptance note already explains why not) or by rewriting the sentence to what the parse and the lint actually do. The fix is small; the record is FAIL until the published text and the tree agree.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: `[]`** in the os-dev-report — nothing to answer.
- **Dev flag: "A blank value inside an inline locale map is not refused."** Answered: correct as a statement of the tree and consistent with the ruling ("empty string refused"); the flaw is that the changeset and the docs assert the opposite. Folded into the ② must-fix. Whether to ALSO refuse blank map values is not escalated: `InlineLocaleMapSchema` is shared by every I18nLabel, and a bespoke second map schema here would fork the vocabulary for one key.
- **Dev flag: "Skills-docs is owed, not done here."** The line `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` is well-formed under the pm-dispatch grammar (`follow-up owed — FILES`); the ruling (6442737825) says the line "is owed on the spec PR", which this is. `skills/**` is Tier H, so keeping it out of the spec half is the right split, and `updated here` is not available: the PR teaches the key in `content/docs` but no eval exercises it. The seat files the owed card and rewrites `owed — FILES` to `#N` before ACCEPT; this record does not substitute for that stroke. The two `objectstack-ui` files are at 0 token headroom (main `0f3d068c` pins two skill line ceilings), so the owed card pays under 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」, as the dev notes.
- **Dev flag: "The renderer half follows" / liveness `planned`.** The direction (spec first, console second) is the ruling's own workload column. The window is acceptable; the row must warn through it (①.9) — must-fix above.
- **The dev-report's `premise_still_valid: true`** holds at the reviewed head: `disabledReasonFor` in `containers.tsx:2372` still returns only the generic sentence.
- **Head freshness.** Three main commits since the merge touch four PR files at disjoint hunks (provenance above); not a flag for the dev, noted for the queue leg.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` — holds.** Tried to break: (a) a predicate-looking value — stays a string, `disabled` beside it still lowers to its CEL envelope (pinned); (b) the `key`/`defaultValue` retired map form — refused by `InlineLocaleMapSchema`'s key regex, pinned via the `label` parity loop; (c) the blank refusal escaping the published schema — `NON_BLANK_STRING` is the registry predicate, so the JSON Schema carries `minLength` + `\S` and the ledger needs no row (a `superRefine` draft would have added 12); (d) leaking into `InlineActionSchema` — not picked, pinned; (e) an unbounded author-facing message — `DISABLED_REASON_BLANK` names the default and the remedy and carries no tracker number (the `[#26619]` marker is in the docblock only, which `check:doc-authoring` permits). Should-fix (non-blocking): the `.describe()` text says the console shows it "(hover title and accessible description)" in the present tense while the liveness row is `planned`; harmless once the console PR lands, but a `[planned]`-style caveat here would also let `markerStatus` agree with the ledger during the window. Not required — the ledger row governs.

**`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` — holds.** One factory, two addresses, siblings `confirmText` / `successMessage` already at both; the bundle-side rename map mirrors the action's; `z.string().optional()` is the right leaf type (a bundle leaf is ONE locale's sentence — never a map). Tried to break: a bound action's bundle at `globalActions` — unchanged refusal path (`translation-target-unknown`), nothing new reaches it. The `validate-translation-references` coverage table now classifies the leaf (`leaf-copy` / `prose`), so the shape and the lint cannot drift apart silently.

**`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` — holds.** `lookupActionField` reads through the single `actionTranslationNode`, so the new leaf cannot disagree with its siblings about the address; the `?? action.disabledReason` fallback and the conditional spread match `description` exactly. `ActionLike.disabledReason?: string` is the same deliberate narrowing `description` carries (the docblock says so), so an inline map is answered as authored — `resolveI18nLabel` (form 2) is the console's job, as for every I18nLabel. No must-fix.

**`packages/spec/src/ui/action.form.ts` — holds.** Plain row under `disabled` in Placement, no widget, I18nLabel face derived from the JSON Schema `anyOf` (SchemaForm walks nested `anyOf` and tolerates `minLength` on the string arm); the `en` bundle leaf equals the row's `helpText`; `check:i18n` reported 10 packages in sync. The helpText quotes the console default in English and says "Display only" — the right thing to tell a Studio author.

**Must-fix (one, two sentences wide, found under ②/①.3/①.9):** the changeset body and `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` claim a blank-map-value refusal the parse does not make, and the changeset/PR body claim a planned-property author warning the ledger row does not opt into. Make the tree say it (`authorWarn: true` + `authorHint` on the `disabledReason` row in `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, to be dropped on the console PR's flip to `live`; and either a projectable record-value refinement or the sentence corrected) or make the text say what the tree does. Re-review on the new head.

**Should-fix:** the present-tense console sentence in the `.describe()` texts of `action.zod.ts` / `translation.zod.ts` during the planned window (cosmetic). Nothing else.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
